verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly describe BYOC/self-hosted deployment that keeps data, models, and infrastructure entirely within the customer's own environment, plus enterprise-readiness page listing managed SaaS, single-tenant, BYOC, self-hosting, and regional endpoints as deployment options. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation of a real self-hosted deployment working (all corroboration is vendor docs, no third-party validation), and no detail on VPC-specific network isolation architecture.
